items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: So anyway, he says, okay, Cozy, and he had it. So, I did the show... I said, now have a fifth of scotch and a fifth of gin up there... I want you to go back in the control room and balance us up the same way as you're doing Arthur. So that's what he did.

ctx.x: Burt Farber was conducting, and so...
